S6-B3145 item 7/8 follow-ups on each breadth holdout read, using the READ's
own frame and grade (breadth_step1_grid.build_frame on the subject run-dir,
breadth_step2_read.grade_holdout; nothing re-selected):

1. CVNA (S6-B3155): re-grade every all-six qualifier with CVNA fires removed;
   count survivors and the qualifiers whose holdout rows hold a CVNA fire.
2. SUBJECT vs CONTROL LIFT: subject lift = qualifier holdout sharpe minus the
   UNFILTERED subject holdout sharpe at the same exit; control lift = the
   read's own control row. Classes (stated criterion, no tuned cut):
   CONTROL-THIN (control lift not computable), SHARED-OR-LARGER (control lift
   >= subject lift), PARTLY-SHARED (0 < control lift < subject lift),
   CONTROL-CLEAN (control lift <= 0).
Writes output_audit/b3145_pairs_breadth_step3_read_checks.json.
